title: Mechanical watch stopped by the emitter

tellings.quote: it was like a mechanical watch that just stopped.

plain: Bob Lazar, a man who says that in the late 1980s he worked on alien craft at S4, a secret site in Nevada, is said to have described a device on the craft, called the emitter, that stopped time near it "like a mechanical watch that just stopped." The researcher Luigi Vendittelli tells this on the show after spending two days with Lazar, passing on what Lazar told him.
